Title: Log in and complete a lesson
Steps:
1. Log in as learner@learnhub.dev / Learn@123
2. Enrol in a course
3. Play the video
4. Click Mark complete
Expected result: Lesson is ticked and course progress increases

Title: Pass the quiz
Steps:
1. Complete every lesson
2. Open the quiz and answer correctly
3. Submit
Expected result: Result shows a score of at least 60% and "Passed"

Title: Sign up a new learner
Steps:
1. Fill name, a new email and a strong password twice
2. Sign up

Title: Catalog filters
Steps: 1. Search, pick a category chip and a level
Expected result: Course count matches the visible cards

Title: Progress survives reload
Steps:
1. Complete a lesson
2. Reload the page

Title: Existing email
Expected result: "An account with this email already exists"

Title: Weak password
Expected result: Strength meter shows Weak and sign-up is blocked

Title: Mark complete waits for video
Expected result: Mark complete is disabled for ~1.5 s, then enabled

Title: Unanswered questions
Expected result: Confirm dialog; "Submit anyway" grades blanks as wrong

Title: Timer auto-submit
Expected result: Quiz submits automatically and shows the result

Title: Enrol, finish, pass and certify
Steps:
1. Log in as learner@learnhub.dev / Learn@123
2. Search Selenium and enrol
3. For each lesson play the video then mark complete
4. Start the quiz and answer all four correctly
5. Submit
Expected result: Progress reaches 100%, quiz scores 100%, and a certificate with an LH- id appears

Title: Sign up and resume later
Steps:
1. Sign up a new learner
2. Enrol in a course and complete one lesson
3. Reload / log in again
4. Open the course
Expected result: Progress and completed lessons are preserved

Title: Unanswered then auto-submit
Steps:
1. Complete all lessons and start the quiz
2. Submit with blanks and choose Submit anyway
3. Retake and let the timer expire (mock the clock)
Expected result: Blank answers are graded wrong; the timed attempt auto-submits to the result
